facts.text: The Stanislaus State Two Year Graduation Pledge Program guarantees graduation within two years for California transfer students with an Associate Degree for Transfer who attend full-time.

sources.title: Finish in Four and Through in Two | California State University ...
sources.quote: The Stanislaus State Two Year Graduation Pledge Program is a program designed to guarantee graduation within two years for students with an Associate Degree for Transfer. The program involves a promise by students to attend full-time and meet program requirements
